title: Piracy—Not the Fun Kind
subtitle: Err, this is a real game-changer for records.

items.text: Simone's statement is definitely a much more damaging bomb.

items.speaker: Attendee I
items.text: Ms. Simone, did you just say something about the Foundation?

items.speaker: Attendee I
items.text: Are we not moving off-topic? We were discussing our efforts to identify substances immune to the "Storm." What is all this about the Foundation?

items.speaker: Medicine Pocket
items.text: No idea, but it's sure to be the most cheerful, positive, wonderful news.

items.speaker: Medicine Pocket
items.text: That'll teach you to run Madam Bucket Head out of town. Now it's going to be those Foundation dimwits calling the shots, ha.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: I won't stand for the Foundation ordering Laplace around. I'll set things straight with them later, you have my word.
He raises his hands in exasperation before promptly dropping them and slumping back into his chair.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: In fact, Ms. Simone, you may relay my message now.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: I understand your concerns, Mr. Enigma. But given our present circumstances, the Foundation's involvement may have a bright side.
She unfolds a neatly prepared document.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: The resolution the Foundation relayed to me was principally concerned with your "Artificial Storm" project, Mr. Ulrich.

items.speaker: Attendee II
items.text: What? Did you switch gears on us, Ulrich?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: For flux's sake! All I did was ask for a little support.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: Speaking of, the Foundation also sent through their approval for your other requests.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: Mostly, anyway. They agreed to supply the majority of your requested materials, including replenishing a portion of our asymmetrical nuclide R, and they've dispatched field investigators to assist us.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: Additionally, they've done preliminary screenings on the locations you mentioned and confirmed they meet the specifications of our experiments.

items.speaker: Attendee I
items.text: The Foundation has never been this generous with us before.
Joy rushes through Ulrich. He feels almost in a daze.

items.speaker: Medicine Pocket
items.text: Don't go popping the champagne just yet, Ulrich!

items.speaker: Medicine Pocket
items.text: Our new bosses aren't going to come anywhere close to replacing all the asymmetrical nuclide R you've wasted!
Ulrich ignores them, his gaze fixated on the letter in Simone's hands.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Still, it's all too easy. What's the catch?

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: They want to witness our results—firsthand.
The table is smacked once again.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Deal!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Someone—anyone—take down the minutes!
Ulrich pounds the table once more, sending waves through the ferrofluid.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: They also sent over another possible location that they haven't been able to confirm.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: A ship.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: The Foundation has requested that you investigate it personally.

items.speaker: Simone
items.text: The Timekeeper will brief you on the details.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fine, Fish Tank, you're off the hook for now.
Regulus glances at them, then her eyes fix on Ulrich, who is calmly removing his disguise.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Just so we're clear. You're not planning to smuggle out my "treasure," right?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I wouldn't think of it.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fab, and you're not angling that I foot the bill for this excursion, right?
Ulrich clears his throat before steering the conversation back on track.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: The Foundation's intel appears accurate. After some preliminary checks, I am certain this will be an ideal locale to conduct our experiments.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I've never seen such intense readings of asymmetrical nuclide R outside of the "Storm."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Now hold on a minute, Ulrich!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You're not about to take a swim, are you?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Only if necessary.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: With my record! You've got to be off your rocker, mate!
Ulrich quickly abates her protestations by presenting her with the record.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Not at all. It's time it was returned to its rightful owner.
She embraces the record like an old friend.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, my darling, oh, my treasure, welcome home! I'll broadcast your tracks on Radio APPLe for 72 hours straight and hold the rockin'-est party ever just for you! Oh! You've got my word!
The joy of this reunion pours out of her, before a graver possibility flashes across her mind.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hold on. You're not about to withhold my funds, are you?!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Fret not, Regulus.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Given its special significance to you, we made its composition analysis our first priority. Now that the first step is done, I'm more than happy to return it to you.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But what about your experiments?
Clutching her "little thing" in her hands, Regulus hesitates, then reluctantly hands it to Ulrich.
Ulrich clears his throat again, donning the feigned formality of his "disguise" once more.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Not to worry. I've already made arrangements.
He proudly raises his coat to unveil Laplace's latest masterpiece.
Dozens of identical "little thing" records are stacked neatly together.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: We went to great lengths to ensure these replicas were identical in every way. We even reproduced the ink used in the signature.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Identical down to their heart and soul, courtesy of Laplace craftsmanship. We've achieved complete consistency in both composition and appearance.
Ulrich's proud tone is cut off by Regulus's exclamation of surprise.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Well, I've got to hand it to you; they're dead-ringers for the real thing.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But this is piracy, and not the fun kind! Musical piracy!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Drastic times call for drastic measures. I hope you'll find it in your heart to forgive us, Regulus.
